stops.date_confidence: Trincado's public advocacy for Sandino is attested by cimamovimientoespirita.org, which records his support for 'la gesta patriótica de Augusto César Sandino en Nicaragua'. stops.stop: Buenos Aires, the school after him
stops.date_confidence: Attested (en.wikipedia): he left the directorship to María Mercedes Riglos Cosis, who delegated it to their eldest son Juan Trincado Donato, died 1992. The 1938 Mexican secession, with its claim of posthumous dictation between 1939 and 1940, comes from Rojas González (UNAM, 2000) through secondary summary and is a religious claim, not a verifiable event. The third link of the succession, Víctor Rolando Trincado, is contested: a 1990 document said to grant him the direction has had its authenticity questioned. Date orders the segment. Riglos is called his companion because the Spanish marriage is nowhere recorded as dissolved.

stops.stop: Colonia Jaime, the ditches still running
stops.date_confidence: Attested as a working communal settlement by Suárez and Infante, Estudios Rurales 12:25 (2022), which also records the colony's 88th anniversary in 2020. The resident figures could not be extracted from the article PDF, which returned as unparseable compressed data; the research pool gave 91 people in 23 family groups and Wikimapia gives 79 people in 25 families. Both counts are named and neither is chosen. Date is the year of the study.
